description:
Morning Reset Music | Slow Sarod | Clear Your Head

Brain still buffering? Before the day gets loud — give your head a moment. Slow Sarod in the morning is a reset, not a ritual. Press play, let it run.

90 minutes of slow Sarod in Raga Bilawal — the classical morning raga — layered with a gentle Alpha wave to ease the mind into alertness without the spike.

🎵 What you'll hear:
- Sarod — a deep-bodied plucked instrument, warm and grounding in the lower register
- Raga Bilawal — the classical morning raga, clear and bright without being jarring
- A quiet Alpha wave layer to nudge the brain toward alert calm
- No percussion, no build-up — just a slow, measured unfolding

⏱ Chapters
0:00   First light
15:00  Settling in
35:00  Head clearing
60:00  Steady and awake
80:00  Ready

🧠 How to use:
Put it on while you have your morning drink, get ready, or just sit. It works as background — you don't need to listen actively.

⏱ Best for:
• Slow mornings before a heavy day
• Brain fog that doesn't lift on its own
• Anyone who needs a quiet start
• Background while getting ready
• Mid-day reset (works any time)

📺 Subscribe to Raga Focus for daily uploads:
- Sitar, Sarangi, Veena, Surbahar, Bansuri, Sarod and other Indian instruments
- Music for anxiety, overthinking, sleep, stress, emotional release

— Raga Focus

thumbnail_prompt: Pichwai/Kangra miniature painting style, ornate gold-and-cream patterned border with subtle lotus and sun-rise motifs, aged warm parchment background, early morning palette (soft golden light, pale blue sky, warm amber). Central figure: calm man in white cotton kurta with gold trim seated cross-legged playing sarod (recognisable as a large fretless plucked instrument resting on the lap) on a rooftop or open courtyard, early morning light washing over him, birds suggested in the distance. Bold dark-teal serif overlay text reading 'START YOUR DAY CLEAR' top-center, traditional Devanagari-influenced serif typography, high contrast for mobile readability. Warm golden-cream parchment palette, alert yet calm mood, single composed scene, no clutter.
suno_prompt: Instrumental only, no vocals. Warm sarod solo in raga Bilawal, bright morning mood, smooth plucked melodic flow with clear articulate notes, no percussion, no tabla, 432Hz tuning, 65-75 BPM moderate-slow tempo, flowing melodic phrases with natural pauses, mid register (warm and grounding, not sharp or piercing), cinematic meditation production, alert and clear, suitable for extended looping. Raga Bilawal tonic C or D. Emotionally: clear, optimistic, like the first hour of a day that might actually go well. Not sleepy, not energetic — settled and ready. Alpha wave layer at -20dB, very subtle.

production_spec.loop_seam: 10s in / 30s out, Suno extend 3-4x → loop in post to fill 90 min
production_spec.notes: Raga Bilawal — classical morning raga, shuddh (natural) swars, bright and clear character. Sarod should feel warm and grounded, not sharp. Alpha 10Hz for alert calm (not Delta/Theta which induce drowsiness). LUFS -14 (louder than sleep content — morning audience is awake and active). EMOTIONAL TAG ROTATION: clip 1: 'clear and optimistic, like a morning that might go well' · clip 2: 'settled and alert, like breath before a good day' · clip 3: 'warm and grounding, like the first light through a window'.

Secondary: Sat AM slot tests whether morning uploads (7am IST) on weekends perform differently from weekday AM. Weekend leisure browsing may push impressions differently.
